title: Hanma Baki
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: The third Baki series (Son of Ogre) follows teenage fighter Baki Hanma as he trains toward a final showdown with his father Yujiro, 'the strongest being on earth', who killed Baki's mother. Along the way Baki faces superhuman opponents, including Pickle, a prehistoric caveman. The series climaxes in a brutal father-son fight that ends in mutual recognition, framed in part through an imagined family dinner (Wikipedia character list; AniList; MU desc; ANN reviews of the earlier series for tone).
life_message: Strength is the measure of a man, but even the strongest must finally recognize his son.

content.note: Graphic, bloody no-rules fights and a gruesome father-son battle leaving Baki broken (Wikipedia; AniList Gore; ANN reviews of the series: 'blood and guts', heavy and graphic).
Psychotic, gloating antagonist Yujiro; near-death injuries (ANN review; Wikipedia).
AniList Rape spoiler tag at low rank; ANN notes uncomfortable 'Oedipal' scenes in the earlier series. Not confirmed for this series, so capped (to verify).
Rude, intimidating characters (MU Rude Character/s, Intimidation) (to verify).
Family trauma from the mother's killing; obsession with killing the father (Wikipedia).
Extreme fighting and training as the path to worth; ANN flags violence and bullying warnings (ANN review; Wikipedia).

dominant: Might makes right; father-son rivalry; martial honor

Dignity vs honor.evidence: Every slight answered by combat; strength defines worth.

Order vs freedom.evidence: No-rules underground arena outside the law.

Civic vs kin.evidence: Father-son blood bond and vengeance for a mother drive the story.

Equality vs hierarchy.evidence: Ranking of the strongest; Yujiro at the top.

Tradition vs secular-rational.evidence: Martial arts lineages and titles (Sea King) honored.

folkways.japan: Martial-arts lineages, ranks and the father as an overwhelming patriarch reflect Japanese budo and family-hierarchy tropes.

delivery.evidence: Characters openly declare strength the measure of worth; ANN calls the tone deliberately over-the-top (to verify).
delivery.note: Yujiro is monstrous yet admired, and the climax ends in mutual recognition rather than condemnation.

winners_losers: Baki and Yujiro end in a tie of mutual respect; victims of Yujiro, including Baki's mother, are casualties. Sympathy goes to strength and fighting spirit.
